+def _compile_pattern(pattern: str) -> Pattern[str]:
+    """Compile a regex pattern, trying regex module first for Unicode property support.
+    
+    The regex module supports Unicode property escapes like \p{Han}, while the
+    standard re module does not. We try regex first, then fall back to re.
+    """
+    try:
+        import regex
+        return regex.compile(pattern)
+    except ImportError:
+        # regex module not available, use standard re
+        return re.compile(pattern)
+    except Exception:
+        # If regex module fails, try standard re as fallback
+        return re.compile(pattern)
+
